theorems.name: Submission.dtc_point_current
theorems.statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (p : Euclid P) (ζ : MultiVector P n), IsOpen U → ∃ X : GeometricCurrentOn U n, (∀ ω : TestFormOn U n, X ω = ζ ((ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) n) p)) ∧ X.support ⊆ {p}
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
